name: Microgroove record
definition: vinyl disc with fine grooves played with a microgroove stylus at 33 1/3, 45 or another speed (LP, EP, single); `diameter`, `speed`, `release_type`, `weight_g` and `mastering` are attributes.
notes: UHQR vinyl record listed at 200 gram, 45 RPM, Clarity Vinyl; sold as record.

name: Coarse-groove (78 rpm) record
definition: shellac or early disc with wide grooves played at about 78 rpm with a coarse stylus (memo † on the term 'coarse-groove' only; the 78 rpm shellac disc is attested).
notes: Lot of 125 vintage 78 RPM shellac records sold (Victor, Columbia, Vocalion).

name: Flexi-disc
definition: thin flexible vinyl sheet record, often bound into magazines.
notes: Flexi discs bound into magazines; sold as flexi-disc singles.

name: Instantaneous disc, acetate or lathe cut
definition: disc cut one at a time on a recording lathe, as an acetate or lacquer, not pressed.
notes: Lathe-cut records cut individually; polycarbonate discs, 7, 8 and 12 inch.

name: Cylinder record
definition: sound recorded in the groove of a cylinder (wax or celluloid) for a phonograph.
notes: Wax and celluloid cylinders; blank 2-minute wax cylinder sold for Edison phonograph.

name: Compact cassette
definition: audio tape in the standard two-hub compact cassette shell, pre-recorded or blank; `tape_type` is an attribute.
notes: Blank Type I cassettes sold new (Revox Grandmaster); Philips 1963; prerecorded Musicassettes.

name: Microcassette family
definition: audio tape in a cassette smaller than the compact cassette (microcassette, minicassette, picocassette; label_source: memo).
notes: Olympus 1969 microcassette; Philips Mini-Cassette 1967; Picocassette 1985.

name: Compact disc, 12 cm
definition: 12 cm optical disc in the Compact Disc Digital Audio system (16-bit, 44.1 kHz), audiobook CDs included; `encoding` (HDCD) and `pressing_material` (SHM-CD, Blu-spec CD2, HQCD) are attributes.
notes: 120 mm disc, Red Book 16-bit 44.1 kHz stereo PCM; 80 mm discs treated apart.

name: SACD
definition: Super Audio CD carrying DSD audio, single-layer or hybrid with a CD layer; `hybrid` is an attribute.
notes: Hybrid Stereo SACD listed for sale as product type; hybrid, single-layer, dual-layer.

name: DVD-Audio
definition: DVD-format disc carrying high-resolution audio (up to 24-bit/192 kHz).
notes: DVD-Audio disc up to 24-bit/192 kHz; DVD-A; DualDisc and HDAD variants.

name: Mini-CD, 3 inch
definition: 8 cm compact disc needing a tray recess or adapter (provisional under F-6: if no seller lists it apart, it is F1.3.3.01 with `diameter` 3 in).
notes: 3 Inch Mini CD-R (80 mm) listed apart from 12 cm discs; mini CD singles.

name: Pre-recorded digital audio player
definition: self-contained device sold with one work (usually an audiobook) fixed on it and able to play only that work (Playaway type; ONIX AK).
notes: Playaway: pre-loaded audiobook device, no downloads, sold from shop; player holds one title.

name: VHS cassette
definition: video recording on half-inch tape in a VHS cassette.
notes: Shops sell used and new VHS tapes; JVC 1976; prerecorded tapes until 2006.

name: Betamax cassette
definition: video recording on half-inch tape in a Betamax cassette.
notes: Sony L-500 Betamax cassettes sold; Betamax cassettes made by Sony until 2016.

name: LaserDisc
definition: 30 cm (or 20 cm) optical disc carrying analogue video.
notes: Criterion Edition LaserDiscs sold on eBay; 300 mm common, 200 mm less so.

name: DVD
definition: 12 cm optical disc carrying standard-definition digital video.
notes: DVD listed as its own section beside Blu-ray and 4K UHD in a deals roundup.

name: Blu-ray
definition: 12 cm optical disc in the Blu-ray system carrying high-definition video.
notes: Blu-ray labelled apart from 4K UHD & Blu-ray at BFI shop.

name: Ultra HD Blu-ray
definition: 12 cm optical disc in the Ultra HD Blu-ray system, listed apart from Blu-ray.
notes: Sold as '4K UHD & Blu-ray' and '4k/UHD'; not playable in standard Blu-ray players.

name: 35 mm print
definition: commercially released film print on 35 mm stock.
notes: Collector offers 92 full-length 35mm feature prints; dealer sale only on a forum classified.

name: 16 mm print
definition: commercially released film print on 16 mm stock.
notes: 16mm SOUND Film cartoon prints (Warner Bros) listed for sale.

name: Super 8 print
definition: commercially released film print on Super 8 stock.
notes: Super 8 film titles listed by a Super 8 dealer; page text names Super 8 shorts.

name: Dust jacket sold alone
definition: loose paper wrapper made to cover one hardback book, sold apart from the book.
notes: Replacement dust jackets sold singly without the book (about 30 titles).

name: Slipcase
definition: open-ended box made to hold and protect one book or one set issued together.
notes: Slipcase: open-fronted box leaving the spine visible, made by a bindery for a book.

name: Comic bag
definition: clear plastic bag sized to hold one comic issue.
notes: Current/Modern Comic Bags sold in 100 count; crystal-clear bags listed.

name: Backing board
definition: stiff board placed behind one comic in its bag to keep it flat.
notes: BCW Current Comic Backing Boards, 6 3/4 x 10 1/2 in, acid-free, 100 per pack.

name: Record inner sleeve
definition: paper or poly sleeve that holds one record disc inside its jacket.
notes: Paper and poly-lined, and HDPE round-bottom inner sleeves listed.

name: Record outer sleeve
definition: clear protective sleeve made to cover one record jacket.
notes: Archival Record Outer Sleeves, 4 mil polyethylene, fit most gatefold jackets.

name: CD jewel case
definition: hinged plastic case made to hold one compact disc with its booklet and tray card.
notes: CD Jewel Cases 10 Pack, polystyrene, for replacing cracked CD cases.

name: Globe stand or meridian
definition: stand, cradle or meridian ring sold for one globe.
notes: Shop page states it offers a new globe base and replacement meridian; listed items were other parts.
